ceo_directive: The first genuine buyer/lab experiment should produce: REAL RAW DATA → provenance → evidence classification → candidate state → knowledge atom → posterior update → EIG → next experiment → package v3. The first time that happens, we can legitimately say: the AI technology-transfer loop has crossed from simulation into reality. That will be a much bigger milestone than another 20 software gates.

path.action: CEO identifies a buyer (shunt company, partner lab, academic center)

path.artifact_produced: Email / handoff record (CEO-owned, not in repo)

path.action: Buyer evaluates package, decides whether to run the decisive experiment
Buyer executes the decisive experiment (bench test, wet lab, clinical data)
Buyer returns raw data file to CEO with provenance metadata
path.artifact_produced: Raw data file + custody metadata (CEO delivers to machine)

path.action: CEO delivers data file to inbound interface
path.artifact_produced: Raw data file at known path + SHA-256

path.action: CEO or independent auditor provides IndependentVerification record
path.artifact_produced: IndependentVerification artifact (DOI, NDA ref, auditor attestation, wet-lab notebook ID, public registry entry)

path.action: Machine constructs AdmissibilityBundle and calls ingest_external_data_v2()
path.machine_role: Construct bundle, call ingest, derive data_source_verified

path.action: If admissibility passes → candidate transitions SYNTHETIC_LOOP_VERIFIED → REAL_LOOP_VERIFIED
Machine updates posterior using Bayes rule with external observation
Machine recomputes EIG with updated posterior
Machine selects next experiment based on new EIG ranking
Machine generates package v3 with all updates
First REAL_LOOP_VERIFIED transition logged as constitutional event
path.artifact_produced: Lineage entry, worklog entry, audit entry

first_milestone_declaration: When step 14 completes, the AI technology-transfer loop has crossed from simulation into reality. That is the next milestone — NOT R341, NOT another software gate.

what_will_change_at_first_milestone.posterior: Buyer-facing posterior updates from 0.6 to a reality-informed value.
what_will_change_at_first_milestone.buyer_package: Package v3 supersedes v2.1. Updated posterior, EIG, next experiment. loop_verification_state=REAL_LOOP_VERIFIED.
what_will_change_at_first_milestone.ceo_perspective: First evidence that the machine can learn from reality, not just from itself.
what_will_change_at_first_milestone.buyer_perspective: The package now contains reality-informed evidence, not just computational modeling.

what_will_NOT_change_at_first_milestone.other_14_candidates: Remain at NONE or SYNTHETIC_LOOP_VERIFIED. Each needs its own external data.
what_will_NOT_change_at_first_milestone.machine_code: No new code. The existing ingest_external_data_v2() handles it.
what_will_NOT_change_at_first_milestone.constitution: No new article. Article XXXVII already defines the transition.

estimated_timeline: CEO-owned. Could be 2 weeks (if a partner lab is ready) or 6+ months (if buyer outreach takes time). Machine cannot accelerate this.
